text:
maria: Heads up — repro'd a duplicate side-effect in the onboarding sampleapp when a 429 hits during token rotation. Steps: 1) hit /generate 2) token refresh race => client retries and triggers the webhook twice. Seen twice in prod-like env.

kai: ugh. do we have an idempotency key on that call in the sample?

maria: nope — sampleapp was intentionally minimal. shows up when SDK client retries without safe-replay guard.

ben: can you paste logs? 

maria: logs: 
```
2026-03-23T15:20:11Z INFO outgoing request id=abc123 token_expired
2026-03-23T15:20:11Z WARN  429 refresh race retrying id=abc123
2026-03-23T15:20:11Z INFO outgoing request id=abc123 delivered webhook payload x2
```

kai: looks like the client increments retry immediately after refresh. We're missing jitter and a replay-safe handshake.

ben: is this Node-only? or across SDKs?

maria: repro'd with node sampleapp and our python shim. go hasn't been tested.

kai: action: add a short adaptive jitter on 429 after refresh, plus a best-effort idempotency header in sampleapp (Idempotency-Key: <req-id>). Should be non-blocking for the tutorial.

ben: agree. also add a note in the SDK parity doc that streaming vs non-streaming retry semantics differ and can cause dup effects. link to docs?

maria: I can submit a patch to the sampleapp and a small test harness that simulates token refresh racing.

kai: please also add an opt-in replay-guard config in the SDK (off by default) so customers can opt in to strict safe-replay semantics if they want. keep defaults friendly.

maria: planned diff: 
```
- await client.request(payload)
+ await client.request(payload, { idempotencyKey: req.id })
+ // fallback: small backoff if refresh happened and we got a 429
```

ben: for the python SDK we'd mirror same behavior. file an SDK parity issue and link PRs.

maria: created a draft PR for sampleapp: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/314 (WIP)

kai: nice. include a unit test that fakes the 429 during token rotate. also add telemetry: count of 'replay-guard prevented duplicate'.

ben: on telemetry, beware PII in payloads — only emit event with request id.

maria: yup — request-id only.

ops-bot: Incident detected: duplicate webhook deliveries spike in staging at 15:20 UTC (auto-opened ticket #ST-1123).

kai: thanks ops-bot. I'll pick this up after lunch. anyone opposed to making the replay-guard opt-in default=true for sampleapp (so tutorials are safe)?

ben: prefer opt-in true for sampleapp (safe by default for examples), but SDK default should stay opt-out to avoid breaking behavior for advanced users. Document prominently.

maria: ok will set sampleapp config to enable replay-guard by default and document how to disable.

kai: followup items: 1) sampleapp PR 2) python/node SDK parity issues 3) unit tests + telemetry 4) release note in onboarding docs. I'll raise a tiny RFC thread in #eng-runtime if parity changes require runtime tweaks.

maria: timeline: patch today, tests tomorrow, canary sampleapp in staging by EOD Friday.

ben: thanks. small suggestion: add a short section in the onboarding README about how to test 429/token refresh locally (we keep repeating the same repro steps).

maria: will add a checklist and a tiny script to simulate token expiry.

kai: cool. tagging @ben for SDK parity review when you open PRs. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — ping me for review.

(dx-bot): linked ticket ST-1123 to PR 314 and added label "dx/dup-on-429".

ben: lgtm, thanks everyone.
